items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to
providing a heart disease presumption for correction officers, correction
supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S8558

SPONSOR: GOUNARDES
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to
providing a heart disease presumption for correction officers,
correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol
supervisors

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To extend eligibility for death benefits and accidental disability bene-
fits in relation to any health condition of impairment of health caused
by diseases of the heart to correction officers, correction supervisors,
deputy sheriff patrol officers or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one amends the retirement and social security law by adding a
new section 63-i to authorize death benefits and disability retirement
for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol
officers or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors who develop a disability
or lose their lives as a result of a heart-related illness while
employed as a correction officer, correction supervisor, deputy sheriff
patrol officer or deputy sheriff patrol supervisor, when there is an
absence of evidence that the impairment is not performance related.

Section two amends the retirement and social security law by adding a
new section 605-g to authorize accidental disability benefits for
correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol offi-
cers or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors who develop a disability or
lose their lives as a result of a heart-related illness while employed
as a correction officer, correction supervisor, deputy sheriff patrol
officer or deputy sheriff patrol supervisor when there is an absence of
evidence that the impairment is not performance related.

Section three provides that this act shall not be subject to section 25
of the retirement and social security law.

Section four provides that this act shall take effect immediately.

 
EXISTING LAW:

Currently, there is no legislative requirement or authorization of a
presumption of heart disease for correction officers, correction super-
visors, deputy sheriff patrol officers or deputy sheriff patrol supervi-
sors in relation to their employment.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol offi-
cers and deputy sheriff patrol supervisors perform duties which are as
stressful and physically demanding as other police officers and first
responders. This bill will provide correction officers, correction
supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol officers and deputy sheriff patrol
supervisors the same benefit pertaining to a heart presumption as is
provided other law enforcement officers.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2020: S3944B - Referred to Civil Service and Pensions

2019: S3944A - Passed Senate, died in Assembly

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

See fiscal note.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

Section four provides that this act shall take effect immediately.
